description: The active products linked to a given product under one link attribute (FrequentlyBought, YouMayAlsoLike), first three in PDP display order with guest prices, category and stock on the store. KB: Product Detail Page; Frequently Bought; You May Also Like.

product.description: PimProductId of the product whose PDP shows the links (e.g. @product.productId)

linkType.description: Link attribute code (ZnodePimAttribute.AttributeCode of a Link attribute): FrequentlyBought or YouMayAlsoLike

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); prices, category and stock are for this store

minLinked.description: Optional: at least this many active linked products (e.g. how many cards the test walks through); left out = at least one
